title: Big Bang, Wormholes, and Piezo2 Within Humans
content: Big Bang theories are connected to gravity by force of attraction. Forced lengthening, like eccentric contractions instigate proprioception as a result of working against gravity. Piezo2, as the principle mechanosensory ion channel responsible for proprioception, may fine modulates these anti-gravitational contractions in order to provide system-wide ultrafast postural control. This mechanism instantaneously emits blast energy by Piezo2 in order to offset gravity and it is suggested to be propagated by quantum tunneling of protons (and electrons). However, wormholes should be considered as part of this ultrafast long-distance non-synaptic neurotransmission despite quantum gravity concept is short of being unequivocally proven to be unified with quantum theory. The impairment of this signaling is the equivalent of the Big Bang within a given compartment, or acquired Piezo2 channelopathy, leading to the principle gateway to pathophysiology.
